tasks.short: Review scientific papers and grants; serve on editorial boards

steps.what: Review papers and grant proposals and deliberate on editorial boards

tasks.design: Retain expert reading, scientific criticism and editorial deliberation using existing {DOCS} and {EMAIL}. Apply the commissioning journal or funder's confidentiality rules before using any assistive tool.
tasks.previous_blocker: Novel scientific claims need discipline-specific assessment and confidential handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing secure document and review channels support the work; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Assess validity, originality, limitations and conflicts of interest.
tasks.human_edge: Take responsibility for a fair scientific assessment.
tasks.altitude: Protect independent scientific judgement and confidential peer review.

reach.task: Clarify review scope and confidentiality requirements

evidence.claim: The digest reports that NWO referees may not use generative AI and that proposal uploads breach confidentiality; this is a named funder restriction, not a rule assumed for every agency.
Expert peer review and editorial deliberation retain full time in this design.

assumptions: The baseline is substantive peer review and board deliberation, not an invented document-formatting process.
The commissioning editor or funding agency supplies the submission and review criteria; the lecturer's reading and clarification time remains in s1.
No new service is installed, so no automation maintenance is added.
unknowns: Commissioning journal and agency tool policies
Share spent on repetitive review administration
research_questions: Is permitted review administration separable from scientific assessment without exposing confidential submissions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net savings 0. Scientific appraisal and editorial responsibility retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide professional scientific consulting to government and industry

steps.what: Provide professional consulting by examining client evidence and explaining scientific advice

tasks.design: Keep problem framing, evidence assessment and client advice with the lecturer using {DOCS} and {EMAIL}. A reusable report generator would need a demonstrated report-production baseline before it receives any saving here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Consulting questions depend on client circumstances and the limits of available scientific evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared documents and communication channels support consultation.
tasks.still_hard: Translate scientific uncertainty into usable advice for a specific decision.
tasks.human_edge: Question client assumptions and explain the consequences of uncertain evidence.
tasks.altitude: Own the quality and boundaries of professional scientific advice.

reach.task: Define the decision and acceptable uncertainty

evidence.claim: Contextual scientific consulting remains human work in this design; no measured clerical subtask or saving is assumed.

assumptions: The baseline includes scoping, reading client evidence, interpretation and communicating advice in s1.
Client representatives supply their question and available evidence; clarification remains counted in the lecturer's consultation time.
No new automation is introduced and no maintenance cost is added.
Teaching, grant review and research work are outside this consulting baseline.
research_questions: Do repeated consulting engagements contain a separately measurable formatting task suitable for native document features?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Client-specific assessment and explanation retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain independent scientific appraisal and contextual professional advice.
reach: Coordinate with editors on review scope
Frame scientific decisions with client technical leads
role.ambitious_version: A science lecturer who provides defensible peer review and consulting advice with clear confidentiality and evidence boundaries.
